title: Confirm launch properties, countries and scope
acceptance: Owner-reviewed Platinum Hotel Mozambique pilot scope, room/role inventory, required integrations and exclusions; multi-property technical qualification remains required; no implied legal/provider eligibility.

title: Measure current staff workflow baseline
acceptance: M01/M02 protocol, role journey inventory and consented/anonymized matched task timings at participating hotels.

title: Validate financial, guest-registration and privacy policies
acceptance: Accountant/legal-reviewed taxes, invoice numbering, deposits, cancellation/no-show, refunds, credit balance, guest reporting and retention per jurisdiction.

title: Validate regional payment provider and merchant readiness
acceptance: Country/currency/payout/refund/terminal eligibility, sandbox access, hosted capture and merchant obligations documented; owner procurement decision.

title: Agree backend architecture, capacity and cost model
acceptance: ADRs for database/identity/hosting/job boundaries; capacity estimate and engineering/operating cost categories reviewed, no invented approvals.

title: Acknowledge ownership and synchronize execution planning
acceptance: Antigravity acknowledges agreement; shared MAS-PM synchronization/principals validated; precise scopes and task splits proposed without granting permissions.

title: Plan selective prototype/frontier integration
acceptance: Reviewed branch divergence and selective integration plan preserves frontier security/ownership; legacy modules inventoried and disabled unless qualified.

title: Implement organization/property data model and migrations
acceptance: Versioned reversible-or-recoverable migrations, membership model and two-org/two-property fixtures; property-local config, room numbering and timezone/currency.

title: Implement production authentication and scoped authorization
acceptance: Privileged MFA, revocation/recovery, secure session behavior and server checks for every resource/file/export/job; negative tests M05.

title: Publish versioned API and operation contract
acceptance: Jointly reviewed OpenAPI, pagination, capabilities, record versions, errors, correlation IDs, durable retry semantics and fixtures.

title: Provision staging, CI and deployment/migration skeleton
acceptance: Separated environments/secrets, candidate-bound CI, smoke checks and reviewed migration rollout; no production activation.

title: Inventory frontend gaps and specify role journeys
acceptance: Core journeys with all loading/error/stale/conflict/permission states and role/property navigation mapped to required APIs.

title: Define design system and approved art direction
acceptance: Accessible component/token specifications, readable typography, semantic status design, EN/PT guidance and image-rights register.

title: Implement property/role-aware shell and safe switching
acceptance: Property identity visible, stale responses rejected, scoped caches cleared, unsaved input handled; group actions require explicit property.

title: Implement accessible components and resilient API client
acceptance: Keyboard/dialog/form states, input preservation, retained operation keys, pagination and version-conflict handling; browser checks at target sizes/zoom.

title: Implement inventory, rates and reservation policy snapshots
acceptance: Room types/sellable inventory, rate/capacity/deposit/cancellation snapshots and business-date semantics tested.

title: Implement concurrent-safe reservation lifecycle and room moves
acceptance: Creation/amend/cancel/no-show/move invariants; M06 races, version conflicts and idempotent commands verified.

title: Implement check-in/out eligibility and exception APIs
acceptance: Clean/unblocked/available room enforcement, dates/occupancy, settlement/credit policy and audited overrides; no client-only policy.

title: Build reservations/calendar and front-desk workspaces
acceptance: Scoped availability/create/amend/arrivals/departures/in-house flows integrate real APIs with retained input and clear property context.

title: Verify reservation/front-desk integration and regression
acceptance: Actual candidate-bound lifecycle/browser/concurrency evidence; hotel supervisor signs scenarios, Codex reviews UI contract.

title: Implement immutable property/legal-entity journal and folios
acceptance: Balanced currency-aware journal, deposits/receivables/earned revenue separation, split folios/routing, reversals and audit golden fixtures.

title: Implement taxes, invoice/receipt rules and financial exports
acceptance: Accountant-approved rounding/numbering/tax examples reconcile; permission-safe/formula-safe exports and no destructive financial edits.

title: Implement nightly posting and resumable business-day close
acceptance: Timezone/DST/late posting fixtures; idempotent nightly close, restart-safe checkpoints and explicit failed/partial close status.

title: Integrate provider capture/refunds and verified webhooks
acceptance: Hosted/tokenized flows, signed/deduplicated/out-of-order events, lost acknowledgement and unknown states; no PAN/CVV storage.

title: Implement tender, shift and provider settlement reconciliation
acceptance: Cash/bank/manual/provider tenders, refund limits and discrepancy workflow; M07 replay/fault fixtures and settlement totals reconcile.

title: Build billing, checkout and reconciliation frontend
blockers: PLG-25 PLG-32 PLG-33 PLG-34 PLG-35 PLG-29
acceptance: Folios/invoices/tenders/refunds/shift close/uncertain payments integrate actual APIs; high-risk confirmations and role-safe details.

title: Qualify finance and payment acceptance
acceptance: Finance independent review, M07, sandbox proof and separately authorized live smoke/settlement evidence; operational runbooks accepted.

title: Implement housekeeping assignment and inspection workflow
acceptance: Distinct occupancy/cleaning/readiness, assignments/priorities and supervisor inspection with audit/version conflicts.

title: Implement emergency maintenance and inventory relocation
acceptance: Out-of-service with current/future stays creates accountable relocation workflow; availability and guest communication states remain safe.

title: Build mobile housekeeping and supervisor workspace
acceptance: Assigned rooms/priorities, safe bulk actions, quick updates and inspection; stale/offline state explicit; M04 task checks.

title: Verify readiness propagation and handover
acceptance: M04 server propagation and browser integration; back-to-back arrivals, room failure and staff handover scenarios reviewed.

title: Implement property/group metrics and actionable exception APIs
acceptance: Reviewed occupancy/ADR/RevPAR definitions, separate currencies, safe drill-down and source/owner/age/next action for every priority exception.

title: Build Today workspace and portfolio management views
acceptance: Role-focused tasks, arrival/payment/cleaning exceptions, scoped portfolio and drill-down with freshness and action accountability.

title: Measure and refine staff productivity
acceptance: Matched M01–M04/M14 study; disclose sample and failures, record improvements and remeasure changed candidate.

title: Implement monitoring, audit retention and incident runbooks
acceptance: Redacted logs, critical synthetic checks, correlation IDs, protected audit retention, alert routing and staffed escalation proposal.

title: Implement off-site recovery and conduct two restore drills
acceptance: Coordinated DB/files/jobs/keys recovery, independent encrypted backups, witnessed M11 and transaction/provider reconciliation.

title: Run independent security and tenant isolation qualification
acceptance: ASVS 5.0 applicable Level 2 mapping, M05, upload/CSRF/session/dependency/config checks; no unresolved critical/high findings.

title: Run backend load, soak and fault qualification
acceptance: M06–M08 scenario dataset, 8h soak, restart/provider faults and correctness/performance results tied to candidate.

title: Qualify accessibility, frontend performance and localization
acceptance: M09/M12 manual keyboard/screen-reader/zoom checks plus browser traces; EN/PT and property currency/timezone examples reviewed.

title: Prepare qualification packet and release recommendation
acceptance: Candidate-specific evidence, independent reviews, known risks, monitoring/support and gate decisions; owner decides production release.

title: Develop and rehearse migration with opening-balance reconciliation
acceptance: Two-property mapping/dedup/import rehearsals; inventory, deposits, balances and guest provenance reconcile; no blind password/session copies.

title: Prepare role training and safe manual continuity guides
acceptance: Role guides, emergency property-safe procedures and training trial M13; hotel staff and Antigravity review correctness.

title: Approve cutover, rollback and support coverage
acceptance: Write fence, backup verification, forward recovery/payment limits and escalation rehearsed; owner-approved staffing and cutover decision.

title: Execute authorized staged multi-property rollout
acceptance: Only after release authorization: candidate deployment, opening totals verified, monitored cohort and documented stop/rollback conditions.

title: Complete operational acceptance and support handover
acceptance: M15 14-day evidence at Platinum Hotel Mozambique, daily inventory/finance close, M01–M04/M13 reports, multi-property synthetic qualification, known issues and owner expansion decision; live second-property acceptance deferred.
